subject: Request: Top-up promo pool for Toastmasters webinar series
messages:
From: Emma Lopez <emma@toastmasters.org>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: promo codes for Toastmasters webinar series (Sept/Oct)

Hi Chloe / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick demo last month — the team at Toastmasters is excited to run a three-part webinar series (Sept 8, Sept 22, Oct 6) targeted at local club leaders. We wanted to check whether Redwood can provide attendee trial codes and an extended redemption window for the series.

What we had in mind:
- 200 single-use promo codes (unique per registrant)
- 45-day redemption window after each event
- Codes should grant a 30-day trial plus a $25 starter credit applied on first use

Attached is a draft attendee list and the rough timeline. Do we need a formal MOU or are you able to approve a promo top-up from your marketing pool? Budget for this partnership is limited — if we can get a partial top-up (e.g., 150 codes now + 50 reserve) that would still be very helpful.

Can you confirm turnaround for the codes and whether distribution via our event vendor (Lumen Events) is supported?

Thanks,
Emma Lopez
Partnerships Manager — Toastmasters International
emma@toastmasters.org
Attachment: attendee_list.csv (stub)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lopez <emma@toastmasters.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: promo codes for Toastmasters webinar series (Sept/Oct)

Emma — thanks for the clear ask, this sounds doable in principle. Two quick clarifications before I loop ops:

1) Redemption window: our standard promo policy supports up to 30 days for single-use codes; 45 days is non-standard and will need a short exception approval.
2) Starter credit: giving a $25 starter credit on first use is fine, but we need to confirm unit economics/chargeback with Marketing (cc Marissa) and Finance (I'll loop priyom if required).

Internal next steps: I can provision codes and either export a CSV for Lumen Events to distribute or issue codes directly through our partner portal. If we grant an exception for 45 days, I'd propose we do 180 codes now + 20 reserve (200 total) to limit exposure.

Marissa / Laura — can you confirm:
- high-level approval to deduct this from marketing promo pool (cost estimate below)
- whether we can make the 45-day redemption exception (or confirm 30 days only)

Estimated cost (very rough): 200 * average starter consumption $25 = $5,000 (recognize some codes may not be redeemed). I’ll mark this as "partner promo" and include the DL-2026-7593 deal tag if approved.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Growth Programs — Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
Attachment: promo_policy.pdf (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Toastmasters promo top-up — cost/ops check

Quick internal note — we ran the numbers: if we approve 200 codes with $25 starter credit each, the gross face value is $5k. Historically our redemption rate for partner promos of this type is ~60%, so expected realized is closer to $3k.

Operational considerations:
- We prefer distribution via partner vendor (Lumen) using a delivered CSV that matches our voucher_batch_template.csv format.
- 45-day redemption is a small risk to recognition and reporting; 30 days is the default to keep consistent with other campaigns.
- We should ring-fence this under deal DL-2026-7593 and tag as "partner-credit" in billing so Marketing can reconcile.

Recommendation: Approve 180 codes + 20 reserve (release reserve only on evidence of demand). Approve 30-day redemption window (exception for 45 days declined). Priyom — can you confirm GL code for chargeback if we proceed?

Thanks,
Marissa 
Head of Growth Programs — Redwood Inference
Attachment: voucher_batch_template.csv (stub)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lopez <emma@toastmasters.org>, Lumen Events <ops@lumenevents.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: promo codes for Toastmasters webinar series (Sept/Oct)

Hi Emma / Lumen Ops — thanks for your patience. Final decision from our side:
- We can provision 180 promo codes up front, with a 20-code reserve that we will release on request if you show signup velocity.
- Redemption window: 30 days after code issue (standard). We can make a one-off exception to extend to 45 days only for the Oct 6 session if you provide a clear business justification; otherwise we must keep 30 days.
- Each code: 30-day trial + $25 starter credit on first use.
- Distribution: we will generate a single-use CSV for Lumen (please confirm the column mapping in the attached template).

Next steps for you (Emma / Lumen):
1) Confirm you accept 180 + 20 reserve under the 30-day standard window.
2) Confirm Lumen can ingest our voucher_batch_template.csv format and return a distribution receipt within 48 hours of upload.
3) Send signed MOU if your procurement requires it — we can accept electronic MOU into legal@redwood.com.

I’ve attached the voucher template and linked the internal promo guidelines for reference. Once you confirm, I’ll open the DL-2026-7593 promo request and provision the codes (ETA: 2 business days after confirmation).

Best,
Chloe Martin
Growth Programs — Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
Related link: https://app.redwood.com/deals/DL-2026-7593
Attachment: voucher_batch_template.csv (stub)
